description:
The 'Nightly-Quality-Gate' job has been failing for several runs. We need to identify exactly when the regression was introduced.

Your task is to:
1. Examine the Console Output of the failed builds to find the FIRST build (chronologically) that failed with the error: 'FATAL: Non-resolvable parent POM'.
2. Once you find that specific build, edit its description to say: 'Regression Start'.

Do not modify any other builds or the job configuration.
